produced_by.notes:
**Puyo Puyo Tsuu** (Puyo Puyo 2) is the 1999 WonderSwan version of Compile's puzzle classic, published by Bandai and released only in Japan. Arle climbs Satan's "Tower" floor by floor and beats its monsters at Puyo Puyo: link four puyo of the same colour to pop them, build chains and bury the rival under nuisance puyo. There is also Toko Puyo (endless practice), two-player link matches and a rule editor.

The translation comes in four versions with the same English text:

* **Black and white:** the game as it was made, a black-and-white WonderSwan game with its original graphics and shades. Normal (upper and lower case) or **ALL CAPS**.
* **Colour:** the game turned into a WonderSwan Color game, normal or ALL CAPS. The five puyo colours are green, yellow, blue, red and purple; each main screen has its own colours, and on the title, the mode and difficulty select, the Tower and the rival select every character, bean, portrait and logo letter gets its own palette. It needs a WonderSwan Color or SwanCrystal, or an emulator.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play, but it must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like). It isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and doesn't belong there.
